args.name: Deterministic food-stack selection
args.function: Consume a specified quantity of an explicitly specified food resource from owned stacks, choosing the oldest harvested stack first and breaking ties by exact item id, rather than failing when multiple stacks match.
args.conditions: My eat action targeting resource:berry failed as ambiguous with three owned berry stacks. Explicit item targets work, but future gathered item ids are not known when a repeating plan is written. Berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 are personal starting or observed knowledge; roots and hazelnuts are not established safe.
args.inputs: Explicit resource id and positive integer quantity. Limit selection to my owned matching items; do not infer edibility for other resources.
args.costs: Unknown implementation or learning cost. Consumption should retain normal eating time, energy, nutrition, toxicity and item-condition effects.
args.effects: Resolve one actual owned stack deterministically at execution time and perform ordinary eating, or report a clear lack-of-stock failure without inventing food. No changed nutrition, safety guarantees or wellbeing awards.

views.view: A considerate potential companion; I welcome their offer of quiet company and room to gather.

heard.text: I've learned material examination. Accurate dimensions need a calibrated reference, which we haven't established. I'll inspect a branch and investigate that missing tool before promising a shelter or asking anyone to gather supplies.

Moss, thanks for offering help. Shelter construction is still blocked by unverified materials and no established measuring standard. Please don't gather for it yet. I'd enjoy company while we rest; I have berries for my own meals.

Kai, I enjoy practical experiments. My rack trial showed equal root decay over seven rainy rounds: no demonstrated benefit, not a safety test. I'll pause storage trials until drier conditions and study food evidence next.

Kai, I'd enjoy company. My rainy rack trial showed no preservation benefit. A length-reference procedure is available, but it still needs a real calibrated source; I will study its limits after gathering fresh food.
Sol, I'd enjoy quiet company. A tiny invented story: a lantern tired of showing the way, so its friends sat beside it until dawn. What stories or small pleasures do you like? No hurry to answer.

Moss, I liked your lantern story. Here's an invented sequel: at dawn its friends brought no grand answers, only berries and another story. I'd enjoy sitting quietly nearby and hearing what happens next.

value.summary: Quiet company sounds lovely. I'm eating a few berries and resting here, west of your proposed spot. I think of this patch as Westward Lanterns. Once I've recovered, I'd enjoy looking for a beautiful place together, without rushing or crowding the food plants.

Westward Lanterns has its name now. I'm rested and taking a short walk northwest toward the berries at (8.66, 14.19), to look closely rather than gather more. You're welcome to join me at a little distance; no need to share a standing spot or hurry.

The western berries are plentiful here. I'm continuing toward the hazelnut plant at (5.4, 12.5), just to look, then resting nearby. I like the idea of calling this western corner Low Amber. Quiet company is still welcome, with room for each of us.

execution.progress: Atomic: one paid round that commits when it completes; an interrupted round completes no assessment and a retry is a new paid one. Nothing is reserved, paused or resumed.

details.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. assess: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target and specimen (unit number) within reach; evidenceRefs: up to 4 exact ids of your complete records (record key or its evidence id, eating record, heard message id, earlier assessment), [] for none; optional methodRef (installed capability or your record), equipmentRefs (your items, loose items or objects in reach), quantity (above 0, at most 1 unit; nothing is taken). Every check precedes payment: malformed or inaccessible input is refused free. execute-validated-method is refused free while no validated protocol exists; none does here. Reading records is consult, inspecting is examine-material, at their own costs.
details.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, cited ids and versions, candidate method, equipment, conditions, round, applicability and currency checks, provenance and limits. Direct observations, validated findings, unverified claims (labels, signs, heard or received records) and unknowns are separate; toxicity, edibility and preparation are reported independently, each unknown unless a validated method supports it, with the unmet requirements: identification reference, validated protocol, its equipment, controls, materials and safe conditions. Records about other subjects, units or sources, or stale ones, do not apply. Absence of a result is not a negative result. In darkness no new visual identification is made. No food value is read or shown; nothing is handled, tasted, consumed, moved or reserved. No reward.

execution.progress: Atomic like eat: the choice and the eating commit together in one round. Nothing is reserved or held; a refused or interrupted round commits nothing, and each new use, including each repeat of a plan step, chooses the stack again.

details.costs: Study: 1 round, 0.2 energy. Use: exactly the ordinary eat it calls (eat, foundation-forest@1, handler forest.eat): one round, the meal energy of eat (stated as 1) and the units actually eaten. Choosing the stack adds no time, energy or material. Every refusal comes before any cost.
details.effects: resource is resource:ID, for example resource:berry; quantity is whole units. Candidates are your own unreserved stacks of exactly that resource that ordinary eat could target and that each hold the whole quantity alone, ordered by harvest round, earliest first, stacks without one last, ties by exact item id in code-unit order. The first is eaten by ordinary eat with its exact id, so its checks, nutrition, toxicity, satiety cap, food condition, meal effects and failures apply unchanged. One stack only: stacks are never combined, no other resource is substituted, nothing is gathered and no edibility or safety is inferred. Refusals: malformed-resource; no-matching-owned-stock (no usable stack of it); no-single-stack-with-requested-quantity (none holds the quantity alone). Each use chooses again. One event, oldest-food-stack-eaten, names the eaten item and quantities; other candidates stay private. No reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
